watchFor: TSV 形成、填孔及晶粒堆疊是不同責任的工序。
凸塊均勻性與電鍍空洞需要各自的量測證據。
影片展示設備能力方向；沒有給出可投產的完整製程窗口。
watchForEn: TSV formation, via filling and die stacking are separate process responsibilities.
Bump uniformity and plating voids need different measurement evidence.
The video introduces equipment capabilities, not a complete qualified production window.
videos.scope: 本課「晶圓暫時接合與解接合」的延伸背景。先進封裝設備與材料處理的共同背景；並非 TSMC、Intel 或每一特殊封裝的製程紀錄。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Temporary wafer bonding and debonding. Shared equipment and materials-processing context for advanced packaging, not a process record for TSMC, Intel or every package type. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.originalTitle: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「載板材料選擇」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Carrier selection requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「化學與真空相容性」列為查證任務：用見證件比質量、厚度和污染。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Chemical and vacuum compatibility: Compare witness mass, thickness and contamination. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：載板支撐、黏著窗口與低損傷解接合。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Carrier support, adhesion window and low-damage release. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 晶圓薄化與背面研磨
related.why: 載板剛性和膠層均勻度傳入薄化厚度
related.whyEn: Carrier stiffness and adhesive uniformity affect thinning thickness
related.transfer: 載板剛性和膠層均勻度傳入薄化厚度
related.transferEn: Carrier stiffness and adhesive uniformity affect thinning thickness
related.difference: 本課還需兼顧可拆解性，研磨課著重材料移除與損傷
related.differenceEn: This course includes releasability; grinding emphasizes removal and damage
practice: 以「載板材料選擇」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「透明度、CTE、剛性和清潔相容性決定載板用途。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「按加工與釋放需求建立材料矩陣。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use carrier selection to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Transparency, CTE, stiffness and cleaning compatibility determine carrier suitability.
Using "Build a material matrix against processing and release needs.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 扇出型晶圓級封裝
related.why: 扇出重組同樣用載板管理薄膜與晶粒
related.whyEn: Fan-out reconstitution similarly uses carriers for films and dies
related.transfer: 扇出重組同樣用載板管理薄膜與晶粒
related.transferEn: Fan-out reconstitution similarly uses carriers for films and dies
related.difference: 晶圓連續片與重組晶粒的局部台階和流動邊界不同
related.differenceEn: Continuous wafers and reconstituted dies have different steps and flow boundaries
practice: 以「熱预算相容性」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「暫時膠需承受加工歷程又保留釋放能力。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「比較加工前後的剪切、滑移和殘膠。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use thermal-budget compatibility to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Temporary adhesive must survive processing while retaining releasability.
Using "Compare shear, slip and residue before/after processing.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

roles.role: 提供暫時接合與解接合設備，可對照載板支撐。
roles.roleEn: Supplies temporary bonding/debonding, relevant to carrier support.
roles.business: 晶圓接合、暫時接合、微影與對位設備（私人公司）。
roles.businessEn: Wafer bonding, temporary bonding, lithography and alignment equipment (privately held).

roles.role: 提供製程材料與清洗化學品，可對照解接合後清潔。
roles.roleEn: Supplies process materials and cleaning chemistries, relevant to post-debond cleaning.
roles.business: 高純材料、微污染控制、流體輸送及 CMP 相關材料。
roles.businessEn: High-purity materials, contamination control, fluid delivery and CMP materials.

roles.role: 提供暫時接合與解接合設備，可對照本課的黏著窗口。
roles.roleEn: Supplies temporary bonding and debonding tools, relevant to the adhesion window here.
roles.business: 晶圓暫時接合／解接合、混合接合、塗佈與光罩對準曝光設備。
roles.businessEn: Temporary bonding/debonding, hybrid bonding, coating and mask-aligner equipment.
